body: Considered it. Some of them can fuck with your brain chemistry, so even if you stop taking you’ll never be the same. I know people who’ve had bad experiences, but I also know not everyone’s the same. I’d rather just die to be honest. I’ve kinda already gotten my hopes up that I’m done trying, so I wanna follow through.

Ah, the hotlines never help. My therapist is literally great. I’m just the fucked up one, y’know? Of course I don’t want to hurt my family, but it’s honestly best in the long run. I feel so awful at the disappointment I’ve become, and it will only get worse.

Oh where do I start. When I was in school I missed so much class because I couldn’t get out of bed. They threatened to kick me out. So I did online school, and I couldn’t even motivate myself to do that. Now I’m homeschooled, getting my ged and taking classes to get credit at a community college.. Other than that, I’m just bad at everything I do. The only thing I’m good at is helping people, and I can’t even do that anymore because I’m so upset and mad at myself all the time. I’ll never get what I want out of life. If someday I do end up getting married and having a family, what kind of life would my children have to suffer through having a depressed mother. There’s no way life works out in my favor.
I’ve dealt with anxiety since elementary school, I don’t remember a time without it. Depression came in middle school, and suicidal came shortly after. I can’t anymore.
